scope: Two native processes, one finite240-tick episode per route/process. Twenty-four retained authority warmup ticks,216 measured rows. Whole-step and nested emitter intervals are not additive. Flight-after-step is an observed endpoint stratum, not exact pre-emitter eligibility. Order groups may also differ by tick parity; samples are temporally correlated, so no confidence interval or whole-game speed claim is made.
decision: One separate sustained crowded paid case is warranted before retention; production remains unchanged.
